tools.description: Existing session actions plus list_devices, add_device, remove_device using target_device_id. reject_call handles an existing incoming call only; no voice/video initiation or acceptance.

action.description: Connection/session operation. login_qr returns a QR image; logout clears stored credentials (destructive)

call_id.description: Call ID from an existing incoming-call event

caller_jid.description: Caller JID from an existing incoming-call event

device_id.description: Act as this device instead of the connection default

phone.description: login_code: phone number in international format (e.g. +628123456789)

target_device_id.description: Registry slot to create or remove, separate from the per-call selected device

tools.name: whatsapp_app

tools.description: Existing per-chat queries, archive and request_history; also pin, unpin, set_disappearing (0/86400/604800/7776000 seconds). Use whatsapp_history for cross-chat archives.

archived.description: archive: true to archive, false to unarchive

count.description: request_history: older messages to request (default 50); asynchronous and best effort

device_id.description: Act as this device instead of the connection default

end_time.description: get_messages: only messages before this RFC3339 timestamp

is_from_me.description: get_messages: filter by sender (true = sent by me)

search.description: list_chats: filter by chat name; get_messages: full-text search

start_time.description: get_messages: only messages after this RFC3339 timestamp

tools.name: whatsapp_chat

tools.description: Read durable device-scoped events after cursor, limit 1..500. Save next_cursor. On cursor_expired rescan chats/history. References only; query messages separately. Native streaming clients subscribe to whatsapp://events.
tools.name: whatsapp_events

tools.description: Existing group actions plus get_photo, set_photo from a staged media_id, remove_photo and bounded JSON export_participants. Removing photos or members is destructive.

announce.description: set_settings: true = only admins can send

device_id.description: Act as this device instead of the connection default

group_id.description: Group JID or numeric ID (all actions except create/join_with_link)

locked.description: set_settings: true = only admins can edit group info

media_id.description: Private image staged by whatsapp_media for the selected device

participants.description: create (optional) / add_participants / remove_participants / promote / demote / manage_join_requests: phone numbers without suffix

request_action.description: manage_join_requests: what to do with the listed requesters

reset.description: invite_link: revoke and regenerate the link (default false)

tools.name: whatsapp_group

tools.description: Device-scoped local archive: search_all with combined filters, chronological context, bounded JSON export, coverage and asynchronous best-effort request_backfill. Stored coverage never proves complete phone history. Text-preferring clients receive JSON results.
tools.name: whatsapp_history

tools.description: Stage an attachment with action=upload, data_base64, filename, mime_type; then send using whatsapp_send media_id. action=read returns bytes over MCP. Maximum 10 MiB/file, 24-hour expiry, device-scoped. No server paths.

include_data.description: Include data_base64 in structuredContent for clients which discard binary content; default false

tools.name: whatsapp_media

tools.description: Operate on an existing WhatsApp message: react, edit, revoke (delete for everyone), delete (for me), mark_read, mark_played, star, unstar, or download_media.

action.description: Operation on an existing message. revoke = delete for everyone (destructive); delete = delete for me only; mark_played sends the played receipt for an incoming audio message; download_media returns private MCP attachment metadata and bytes when MCP data storage is enabled

device_id.description: Act as this device instead of the connection default

emoji.description: action=react: emoji to react with; empty string removes the reaction

inline.description: download_media: embed image or binary MCP content (default true); false returns a private MCP resource URI

message.description: action=edit: replacement text (works ~15 minutes after send)

phone.description: Phone number or group JID of the chat containing the message

tools.name: whatsapp_message

tools.description: List subscribed channels, get_messages with count/before pagination, private download_media by server_id, and unfollow. Follow/join and publishing are not exposed by the pinned GoWA REST usecase.
tools.name: whatsapp_newsletter

tools.description: Get profile/avatar/business profile/privacy. Update own push name or avatar with staged media_id; update_profile accepts exactly one of those fields. Privacy and business-profile writes are unsupported. phone defaults to the selected account for reads.
tools.name: whatsapp_profile

tools.description: List and manage scheduled WhatsApp sends. Actions: list, get, pause, resume, cancel. Only an active schedule can be paused, only a paused one resumed, and active, paused, or failed ones cancelled.

message_type.description: action=list: only this kind of scheduled send (file = whatsapp_send type=document)

search.description: action=list: match recipient or message text

status.description: action=list: only schedules in this status

tools.name: whatsapp_schedule

tools.description: Send text/media and existing message types. Additional types: presence (available/unavailable), chat_presence (start/stop), status (status_type text/image/video; broadcasts to the account's existing status privacy audience, not a single recipient).

audio_url.description: type=audio: URL of the audio file (fetched server-side)

compress.description: image (default true) / video (default false): re-encode before sending

day_of_month.description: recurrence=monthly (required): day to send, clamped to the month's last day

device_id.description: Act as this device instead of the connection default (X-Device-Id header)

end_at.description: Recurring only: RFC3339 time after which no more sends happen

file_url.description: type=document: URL of the file; MIME type and filename derived server-side

force_reupload.description: type=forward: re-upload media instead of reusing references (default false)

gif_playback.description: type=video: play as looping GIF (default false)

hd.description: image/video: send HD without upscaling (image: 2560px max edge; video: H.264 8-bit YUV 4:2:0 at CRF 23, capped at 1280x1280); overrides compress when true (default false)

image_url.description: type=image: URL of the image (fetched server-side)

is_forwarded.description: Mark the message as forwarded (default false)

media_id.description: Attachment staged by whatsapp_media; replaces the matching media URL and is scoped to this device

mentions.description: text/image/video/document: ghost mentions; "@everyone" mentions all group participants

message_id.description: type=forward: source message ID from chat storage

occurrence_limit.description: Recurring only: stop after this many sends

phone.description: Destination phone number or group JID

ptt.description: type=audio: send as voice note (requires ffmpeg server-side, default false)

recurrence.description: Repeat pattern for a scheduled send (default once)

reply_message_id.description: type=text: message ID to reply to

scheduled_at.description: Schedule instead of sending now: RFC3339 time of the first send (must be in the future)

sticker_url.description: type=sticker: URL of an image to convert to a WebP sticker

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Asia/Jakarta); required when scheduled_at is set

video_url.description: type=video: URL of the video (mp4/mkv/avi, fetched server-side)

tools.name: whatsapp_send
